intent: Metric 2 metrics: world productivity and its change since GTA V

edits.new_content:
version: 2
metrics:
- name: day_off_index
  label: Day-Off Index
  description: 'Average year-over-year change, in percent, of US Google searches for call in sick, sick
    day and day off work over the configured window (canonical: 1-14 Nov 2026 vs 2-15 Nov 2025). 50 =
    searches up 50% on average. Never report it alone: always with its breakdown (group by day_off_index_window__breakdown,
    or query day_off_index_term_change by day_off_index_term__term).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: day_off_index_measure
- name: day_off_index_term_change
  label: Day-Off Index, change by phrase
  description: 'The breakdown: one phrase''s year-over-year change in average weekly search interest,
    in percent. Group by day_off_index_term__term.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_pct_change
- name: day_off_index_term_current
  label: Search interest, current window
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the current window (0-100 on that phrase's
    own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_current_avg_interest
- name: day_off_index_term_prior
  label: Search interest, a year earlier
  description: A phrase's average weekly search interest over the same weeks a year earlier (0-100 on
    that phrase's own scale). Group by day_off_index_term__term.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: term_prior_avg_interest
- name: signal_value
  label: Signal value
  description: Daily value of a signal. Always group by signal_day__source and signal_day__signal; never
    add across signals.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
- name: day_off_mentions
  label: Day-off mentions
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off (any reason), summed over seed phrases. Group by
    signal_day__source.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off''

    '
- name: day_off_mentions_gta
  label: Day-off mentions that say GTA
  description: Posts saying someone is taking time off that also mention GTA.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''posts:day_off_gta''

    '
- name: gta_share_of_day_off_talk
  label: GTA share of day-off talk
  description: Day-off posts that mention GTA, as a share of all day-off posts. A fraction (0 to 1). Thursday-is-chattier
    effects cancel out.
  type: ratio
  type_params:
    numerator: day_off_mentions_gta
    denominator: day_off_mentions
- name: gta_wiki_pageviews
  label: GTA VI Wikipedia pageviews
  description: Daily user pageviews of the English Wikipedia article Grand Theft Auto VI. The hype line.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: signal_value_measure
  filter: '{{ Dimension(''signal_day__signal'') }} = ''pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi''

    '

- name: world_productivity
  label: World productivity
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6. World real output in one year, in the measure''s unit: output_per_worker is World Bank GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP $), output_per_person is World Bank GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$). Always group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year; never add across measures or years.'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: value

- name: world_productivity_change_since_gta_v
  label: World productivity, change since GTA V
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6. Real change in world productivity since GTA V''s launch year (2013), in percent. Group by world_productivity_key__measure and world_productivity_key__data_year. The headline year is 2026 (GTA 6) for output_per_person, an IMF-carried estimate (world_productivity_key__is_estimate), and the latest published year for output_per_worker (2026 reads NULL: unavailable).'
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: pct_change_since_gta_v
